The '''Prishardia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Antemeridian sector/Legends|Antemeridian sector]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Prishardia]].<ref name="EAOC" />
